idea-plugin.name: Nebula Violet Theme
idea-plugin.description:
A deep dark-purple theme: near-black violet chrome, a plum editor, warm orange keywords, golden functions, green strings and sky-blue members.

Two variants are included:

  • Nebula Violet: the classic flat layout, for the Classic UI and for anyone who prefers the standard New UI look.
  • Nebula Violet Islands: the same palette on the Islands layout (2025.3+), with rounded tool windows and editor islands floating on a darker frame.

Choose one under Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Appearance | Theme. Both come with the matching Nebula Violet editor color scheme.
